title: SBPR.QaHarness.T022 receipt (ADR-0009 §6) — M1 admission shape + M4 evidence shape
description: The DESCRIPTIVE primitive-fact receipt the helper emits per request. It NEVER contains a product PASS/FAIL verdict — only the external runner composes a verdict (ADR-0009 §6). Two outcome vocabularies coexist: the M1 admission-decision shape (admitted/rejected/replayed, 'reason' mirrors Core/RejectReason.cs) and the M4 evidence-primitive shape (OK/REJECTED/BUSY/TIMEOUT/CANCELLED — a mechanical outcome with deliberately NO PASS/FAIL member, see Evidence/RedactedReceipt.cs::ReceiptOutcome). The M4 shape adds 'connectionGeneration' (stale-replay binding, §10) and carries only redacted 'observed' facts (present KEY names + bounded value digests, never a raw signature value). The helper still exposes no live channel; this schema pins the shape.

connectionGeneration.description: M4 (§10): the connection generation this receipt was minted on. A receipt from an older generation is stale after a reconnect (Evidence/ReceiptHashChain.cs::ReceiptCache).

outcome.description: M1 admission decision (admitted/rejected/replayed) OR M4 mechanical evidence outcome (OK/REJECTED/BUSY/TIMEOUT/CANCELLED). There is deliberately NO PASS/FAIL — a product verdict is the external runner's sole authority (ADR-0009 §6).

reason.description: The RejectReason that fired (None when admitted). Mirrors Core/RejectReason.cs.

observed.description: Descriptive facts only (e.g. tooltip text, field-present bool, quality int). Never a product verdict.
